Self.Wiki: This map object represents a scripted map gimmick, such as a catapult or elevator. The gimmick is run by a talk script chosen through MapGimmickParam, and gathers the points and parts that the script uses. Retail uses it for the catapults in Illegal Entry (m10_00_00_00) and a test catapult (m03_60_00_00).

MapGimmickParamID.Wiki: The MapGimmickParam row for this gimmick. The row's Gimmick Type picks the talk script: Gimmick Type AABB loads script/talk/m02_AA_BB_00.talkesdbnd (retail catapults use 0 and 3, the test elevators 2).

StartPointName.Wiki: The gimmick's main point, given to the talk script as point 1. On the retail catapults this is where the launch starts, above the launcher.

ControllerPartName.Wiki: The part that runs the gimmick's talk script. The talk script is only loaded when this is set. Illegal Entry uses a c9980 system character.

PartNames.Wiki: A part that belongs to the gimmick, such as the launcher assets of a catapult. Up to 16.

RoutePointNames.Wiki: A point used by the gimmick, in order; the talk script gets them as points 35 onwards. On the retail catapults these are the flight path, ending in a cylinder at the landing area. Up to 16.
